The best IRB CZ pair on real garnet is QB12-QB11. I read this from the default calibration set f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade. Its IRB CZ fidelity is 0.99869, with an uncertainty of +/- 0.00035. The metric field is metrics.irb.cz.slepian_crf.QB12__QB11.fidelity:par=d2. The next best pair is QB12-QB7 at 0.99802.

I ran a Bell circuit on garnet:mock with 100 shots. It used native IQM operations on the physical qubits QB12 and QB11, so no transpiler could remap the qubits. The circuit was prx on both qubits, then cz(QB12, QB11), then prx on QB11, then one measure on (QB12, QB11) with key m. The job ID is 01a15fa2-fd6a-7609-a106-4f44581b2d90, and it completed.

Counts, with QB12 as the left bit and QB11 as the right bit: 00=26, 01=20, 10=29, 11=25. The results are spread evenly over all four outcomes because the mock returns random results. They do not show Bell correlations. The mock job cost 0 estimated credits.
